decisions.reason: As a declared flagship with repeated gold-medal recognition, this stollen is performing clearly above aspiration and remains strategically valuable for the firm's identity.
After surviving the first review, this seeded rye mixed bread appears to fit the core assortment well enough to meet aspiration while requiring little extra strain on existing bakery resources.

This dark barley malt rye bread is still the most vulnerable of the remaining breads because it is more niche, but in a growing market and after pruning other launches the firm would likely give it another year unless sales now fall visibly below aspiration.
